label: Gadgets & Appliances

discovery.paste_hint: Paste store numbers if you have them

in_stock.ask_hint: is the exact variant available today?

conditions.ask_hint: cash only? exchange needed? bill included?

validity.ask_hint: how long can they hold this price today?

extra_rules: if they have no stock, ask once whether a nearby branch has it, then wrap

knowledge: MRP is a legal ceiling, not the selling price - genuine street price is always below it
exchange bonus is a promotional discount on top of the old device's real value; ask for both itemised separately
bank card instant discounts and no-cost EMI stack on top of a negotiated price - ask which banks qualify today
extended warranty is the store's highest-margin add-on: always optional, often free on a big ticket
a proper GST bill is non-negotiable - warranty is invalid without it
levers: extra discount for full cash or UPI payment today
free cover, screen guard, or accessories when the price is stuck
open-box or demo unit at a real discount with full warranty, if they mention one

objections.them: price is fixed by the company, MRP is fixed
objections.move: MRP is the ceiling, not the price - ask what discount off MRP is realistic today

objections.them: extended warranty is compulsory for this discount
objections.move: it is optional by law - ask for the base price without it

objections.them: exchange bonus is fixed by policy
objections.move: ask for plain exchange value and promotional bonus quoted separately

objections.them: installation or delivery is billed separately
objections.move: ask for it to be included at this price
